**RetroDrive {{VERSION}} is a beta.** It's free and open source (Apache-2.0) and runs on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).

RetroDrive catalogs the retro games you already own, copies them safely to the systems you play on (RetroBat, Batocera, RetroPie, ES-DE, Recalbox, ROCKNIX, Knulli, Lakka), keeps them in sync, backs up your saves, sets up controllers and light guns, and lets you design your own themes. See [FEATURES.md](https://github.com/gollum10/RetroDrive/blob/main/FEATURES.md) for everything it does, and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gollum10/RetroDrive/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.

### Download

- **RetroDrive_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe** is the usual installer. Download this one.
- **RetroDrive_{{VERSION}}_x64_en-US.msi** is the same app as a Windows Installer package, for people who prefer MSI.

### "Windows protected your PC"

This beta isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you before it runs. If you downloaded it from this page, choose **More info → Run anyway**. To check that your download is exactly the file built here, compare its SHA-256 checksum with the list below. In PowerShell, run `Get-FileHash .\RetroDrive_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe`.

### Bring your own games

RetroDrive is for your own games, for personal use. It doesn't include, sell or download any games, BIOS files, firmware or game art. It works with emulation systems you install yourself, and it isn't connected with or endorsed by any of them.

### Your files and your privacy

- RetroDrive never overwrites or deletes your files. Anything it replaces is backed up first and can be undone.
- There's no account and no telemetry. RetroDrive sends nothing about you.
- The optional AI helpers in Theme Studio only connect when you set them up with your own account or your own private AI.

### Beta notes

- There are no automatic updates yet. Download new versions from this page.
- Please report problems on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/gollum10/RetroDrive/issues).
